Method of Attack: Malvertising campaign leveraging pop-under ads that redirect users through a Traffic Distribution System (TDS) and multiple redirections to the landing page of an instance of the RIG exploit kit, ultimately spreading the Ramnit banking trojan
Steals credentials and money from online banking portals, behaves like an infostealer dumping passwords from browsers and other applications
Impacted Systems: Online banking portals in Canada and the UK
Attack Vector: Malicious pop-under ads on adult websites including See.xxx and Justporno.tv
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious ads served via advertising network ExoClick
Pop-under ads redirecting to RIG exploit kit landing page
Geolocation filters targeting Canada and the UK
